LESSON: HEALING BY THE END OF THE SUB

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The
Topic 3.4: Healing By the end of the sub

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Healing By the end of the sub. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

You will learn the key ideas about Healing By the end of the sub and use them at home and at school.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

Read about Healing By the end of the sub with your parent or teacher. Say what it means in your own words.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Healing By the end of the sub.
2. Explain Healing By the end of the sub to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: Digital Literacy: the skill of connecting using technology is portrayed as learners watch a video clip on the birth of John the Baptist.
4. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Healing By the end of the sub. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Healing By the end of the sub important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Digital Literacy: the skill of connecting using technology is portrayed as learners watch a video clip on the birth of John the Baptist.
2. Creative Arts: creative skills are reinforced as learners sing and role play.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. Healing By the end of the sub is important in everyday life.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
